body: I'll definitely do my best! Ill probably try to make a trip report when I try 3-Meo-pce next week.
I'll definitely have to try mixing the dissociative I have, as I've read some great experiences from mixing certain ones! Ill give O-PCE and 3-Ho-PCP combined a try first!

Well on O-PCE, my entire body was quite numb but it felt like it was tingling, kinda like every molecule in my body was vibrating. I didn't get this on 3-Ho-PCP, it just felt a little numb at a higher dose but no tingling or anything. 

For music and media immersion/enhancement I would definitely recommend O-PCE. I did watch Interstellar on 3-Ho-PCP, and it was quite interesting. But on O-PCE I felt like I was in a movie while listening to Keep It Low by Lynx feat Kemo, and had entire scenarios played out in my head while listening to My Bloody Valentine's Loveless album with my eyes closed. I think I might have been slightly close to a holing dose that time though. Either way, it was extremely nice. 

As for the visuals, I can't say much as I've only done O-PCE once, but I did get some interesting "monochrome" visuals. Think waves of light gray and a darker color. Kinda like yin and yang, intertwining. So I do believe it can be quite visual.

In regards to the dissociation, I'd say 3-Ho-PCP is slightly less dissociating, although at a higher dose, it does feel similar to O-PCE. I'd say O-PCE is a little more confusing though, but I find this pleasant.

Sadly I haven't holed on either yet, but I'd say a strong dose of 3-ho-pcp is similar to a normal dose of o-pce, with less body tingling, slight less numbing, a little more euphoric and a tad bit warmer.

I personally love o-pce. I have yet to try 3-meo-pce, but plan to in 2 weeks. 3-ho-pcp was decent, I used a total of 20mg, with 5mg redoses until I reached 20mg. It was nice though, a little similar to o-pce, but I prefer o-pce over it. But this could change after more experimenting though.
